parole.significato: A shrub belonging to the section Vaccinium sect. Oxycoccus of the genus Vaccinium.
parole.testo: Adapted in the 1640s from Dutch Low Saxon or German Low German Kraanbeere, from Kraan m (which means and is cognate with crane) + Beere f (which means and is cognate with berry).
